content:
🌈彩虹附魔光澤效果
-
為附魔光澤帶來全新外觀，相容於 1.15+ 版本。  
此資源包在 1.19.4 以下版本中的視覺效果可能略有差異。  

✨功能特色
-
此資源包透過替換紋理，將附魔光澤效果替換為以下特定視覺效果：
| 顏色             | 圖案               | 效果              |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|---------------------:|
| 彩虹            | -              | 色彩漸層             |

|---------------------|---------------------:|

| [Red to Yellow Gradient](https://modrinth.com/project/arzSOyQ7)           | [Rainbow Spots](https://modrinth.com/project/IcKGz9QV)              |
| [Yellow to Green Gradient](https://modrinth.com/project/w7PpEeGS)           | [Rainbow Transition](https://modrinth.com/project/80iA767F)              |
| [Cyan to Blue Gradient](https://modrinth.com/project/J7gyiMMJ)           |[Rainbow Transition Rect. Frames](https://modrinth.com/project/VXFxgCxR)              |
| [Blue to Magenta Gradient](https://modrinth.com/project/fibHtE00)           |[Rainbow Pulse SGA](https://modrinth.com/project/vwH5QJDU)              | -
| [C-M-Y Gradient](https://modrinth.com/project/gexnR8g8)          |[Rainbow Binary Code](https://modrinth.com/project/evf7KZ5q)              | -
| [Gold Gradient](https://modrinth.com/project/QMsKkhM9)         |[Rainbow Cosmoic Dust](https://modrinth.com/project/sORlCzei)              | -
